title: descriptive_summary.json
description: Output of tools/chart_summary.py (docs/PLAN.md M3 §3.1 S7), the descriptive-synthesis engine for a scoping review's charted studies or a systematic mapping study's classified studies. Never contains a pooled effect estimate -- synthesis_family: "descriptive" forbids pooling by design.

category_frequencies.description: One key per charted field / classification facet name; each value is {category_value_as_string: count}.

cross_tabs.description: Pairwise facet cross-tabulations (classification only -- always empty for capture_mode "charting"); the data a bubble plot renders. Rendering the plot itself is not yet implemented.

counts.description: Key is "value_a|value_b"; value is the count of studies with that combination.
